sections_restyle_guidance.Sticky Navbar: Use crystal glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with a delicate border-b border-slate-100. Logo left, Nav center, Lang toggle (ID/EN) and 'Bergabung' primary button right. Keep mobile menu elegant with full-screen white overlay.
sections_restyle_guidance.Hero: Kinetic multi-line H1 using Cormorant Garamond. Background: subtle abstract blue map network image with low opacity overlay (bg-white/95). Grand Launching badge: elegant gold pill chip. Two CTAs (Primary Navy, Secondary Gold border).
sections_restyle_guidance.Marquee text strip: Editorial ribbon style. Very slow smooth drift. Background: #FAFAFA. Text: uppercase Manrope, tracking-[0.3em], text-emerald-800, text-sm.
sections_restyle_guidance.Urgency stats: Clean white background. 3 stats in a row. Huge serif numbers (text-6xl text-[#0A192F]), subtle Slate-500 descriptions. Thin 1px vertical dividers between stats on desktop. Editorial panel text gracefully aligned alongside.
sections_restyle_guidance.Ecosystem section: Minimalist grid layout. 1px borders, generous p-8 padding. Five cooperation pillar chips positioned below. No heavy backgrounds, keep it off-white.
sections_restyle_guidance.Four Mission Pillars: Editorial rows. Left: 3x4 aspect ratio image. Right: Huge step number (01, 02) in thin gold serif + descriptive text. Alternate left/right alignment per row. Use massive gaps (gap-16).
sections_restyle_guidance.Programs: Sticky-top header on the left column (md:col-span-4). Right column (md:col-span-8) has 6 clean cards with minimal icons (Emerald) and crisp typography.
sections_restyle_guidance.Roadmap timeline: Minimalist vertical line (border-l) or offset horizontal blocks. Alternating text blocks with thin lines. Use tiny gold dots for nodes. Restrained typography.
sections_restyle_guidance.Governance leadership: Horizontal drag-to-scroll carousel. 3x4 portrait photos. Name and initials directly below in clean sans-serif. No visible card borders, purely image-driven.
sections_restyle_guidance.News mosaic: 4-card asymmetrical bento grid. 1st card large (col-span-full md:col-span-2 row-span-2). Text overlaid cleanly at the bottom using subtle linear gradient. Minimalist.
sections_restyle_guidance.Video feature: Clean 16:9 full-width or inset container with rounded-2xl. Play button is a blurred glassmorphism circle in center. Quote panel below in large italic serif text.
sections_restyle_guidance.Paid Publications: 3 clean pricing-style cards. White bg, emerald text for highlights. 'Buy' button is secondary style. Modal prototype must use backdrop-blur.
sections_restyle_guidance.Join CTA: Minimalist split layout. Left: large elegant text. Right: clean form with border-bottom ONLY inputs (no enclosed boxes). Primary CTA button right-aligned.
sections_restyle_guidance.Footer: Background #FAFAFA. Minimalist 4-column grid. Thin 1px border on top. Navy logo. Small text for nav and contact. Generous spacing (py-24).
sections_restyle_guidance.Cookie consent banner: Floating pill at bottom-left. White bg, sharp drop-shadow. Minimal text, 'Accept' as small emerald text, 'Decline' as slate text.
sections_restyle_guidance.News Detail page: Hero image max-h-[60vh] object-cover. Title cleanly below. Max-w-3xl for reading text, editorial drop-cap for first letter. WhatsApp share button as floating circular emerald icon. Clean related news grid at bottom.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT change existing functionality, props, CMS data model, or data-testids. This is purely a UI/UX restyle.
Install and use Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main layout wrapper.
Apply Framer Motion selectively for fade-ups and stagger effects. Avoid over-animating.
Use generous whitespace (p-16 to p-32) to emulate gbhi.org elegance.
All cards/borders must use subtle slate-100/200 (not harsh black) to maintain an elegant, lightweight feel.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts; do NOT use Shadcn Card components if they restrict custom spacing.
Do NOT use 'transparent' background in the sticky header; use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 instead to ensure readability.
Retain all bilingual (ID/EN) text structures and CMS injection points.
Ensure contrast ratio meets minimum 4.5:1 (WCAG AA) across all text elements.
